one_sentence_story: While measuring digestion in St. Petersburg, Ivan Pavlov discovered that a neutral ticking metronome played right before meals rewires a dog's brain so the sound alone switches on its salivary glands.
so_what_for_you: Every time a phone ping, snack-bag crinkle, or coffee-shop smell makes your hand twitch or your mouth water before you even think, your brain is firing a Pavlovian reflex built from repeated timing.
